description: This set of C# Multiple Choice Questions & Answers (MCQs) focuses on "Introduction of array class".

questions.question: Select the class which is the base class for all arrays in C#?
Select the interfaces implemented by array class.

options.text: Only IEnumerable, IStructuralComparable, IStructuralEquatable & ICloneable, ICollection, IList

questions.question: Choose the correct statement about the IComparer interface in C#?

options.text: The IComparer interface is in System.Collections
It defines a method called Compare(), which compares the values of two objects
Both The IComparer interface is in System.Collections & It defines a method called Compare(), which compares the values of two objects

questions.explanation: The IComparer interface is in System.Collections. It defines a method called Compare(), which compares the values of two objects. It is shown here: int Compare(object x, object y). It returns greater than zero if x is greater than y, less than zero if x is less than y, and zero if the two values are equal.

questions.question: Choose the correct statement about the IComparer<T> interface in C#?

options.text: It defines a generic form of Compare()
Only The IComparer<T> is in System.Collections.Generic
Both The IComparer is in System.Collections.Generic & It defines a generic form of Compare()

questions.explanation:
IComparer<T> is in System.Collections.Generic. It defines a generic form of Compare(), which is shown here:

 int Compare(T x, T y). It works the same as its non-generic relative: returning greater than zero if x is greater than

y, less than zero if x is less than y, and zero if the two values are equal.

questions.question: What does the following property defined in the array class defines in C#?

options.text: a property is read only by nature
property is true if the array object is read only and false otherwise

questions.explanation: A read-only property that is true if the Array object is read-only and false if it is not. This value is false for arrays.

questions.question: What does the following property define in C#?
questions.code: public static int BinarySearch<T>(T[] array, int index, int length, T value)

options.text: Searches a portion of the array specified by array for the value specified by value
The search begins at the index specified by index and is restricted to length elements. Returns the index of the first match
If value is not found, returns a zero value

questions.explanation: Searches a portion of the array specified by array for the value specified by value. The search begins at the index specified by index and is restricted to length elements. Returns the index of the first match. If the value is not found, returns a negative value. The array should be sorted and one-dimensional.
